description: Python web app built on Streamlit, utilizing LangChain and the OpenAI API to automate YouTube title and script generation. The app offers a prompt-based interaction system, leveraging conversational memory and Wikipedia research. Resulting in a streamlined user interface to showcase outputs, history, and related Wikipedia research.
